settings.title: Exactly as described
settings.body: Fits true to size — I'm 5'11" and took a size 40. The wool has real weight to it.
settings.author: T. Bennett

settings.title: Great jacket, sleeves ran long
settings.body: Had to get the sleeves taken in about an inch, but the tailor said the cloth was excellent to work with.
settings.author: D. Osei
settings.reply: Thanks for the note — we're updating our sleeve-length guidance for tall sizes based on feedback like this.
